turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’ve been in home hospice, and lately I’ve been much more confused than usual and can’t always get my thoughts out clearly. I’ve also had a fever and some discomfort in the right upper part of my belly.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your eyesight, such as blurriness, dark spots, or any degree of vision loss?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any blurriness or dark spots, though I’m not entirely sure because I’ve been feeling too confused to check my vision carefully. I can tell you I’ve had a fever and discomfort in the right upper part of my belly.

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: Doctor: Do you currently smoke or have you ever smoked? Patient: I don’t remember any smoking habit—if I ever did, it wasn’t something ongoing.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: Yes, I’ve felt nauseated and generally “sick to my stomach” at times, though with my confusion it’s been hard to say exactly when it started or how severe it’s been.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area, and I haven’t felt any pain there. With my confusion, I can’t guarantee I’ve checked thoroughly, but nothing stands out to me.

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can often be linked to how we are feeling overall. Lately, have you been experiencing a significant amount of stress or emotional strain in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: I’ve been under a lot of strain in daily life with hospice and feeling unwell, but I can’t say it’s “stress” in the usual sense—mostly it’s been worrying and tiring. I don’t feel emotionally like myself, and I’m confused more often than before.

turns.doctor_question: To help me better understand your current symptoms, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine, such as it appearing darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I can’t say for sure because I haven’t been able to closely observe my urine, but I don’t recall it being unusually dark or different in color. If you want, someone can check and tell you what it looks like.

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, could you tell me if you have noticed this breast mass growing or changing in size rapidly over a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any breast lump or anything changing in size, so there’s nothing I can say is growing or changing quickly. With my confusion, I may not have checked as often as I should, but I don’t think I’ve seen a new mass.

turns.doctor_question: I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. To help me better understand what might be going on, could you tell me if you have been experiencing any pain in your wrist?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t think I’ve had any pain in my wrist. My discomfort has mostly been in the right upper part of my belly, and I’ve also had a fever and confusion.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a clearer picture of what you're experiencing, could you please tell me if you have noticed any skin lesions, rashes, or unusual marks running along the veins of your arms?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t think I’ve noticed any rashes or unusual marks on my arms, and I haven’t seen anything that looks like it’s running along the veins. With the confusion, it’s possible I missed something, though.
